scope: Provenance of original character assets and the three black-and-white manga excerpts used in Ema. This file is not a permission or license grant. Third-party media are excluded from the repository software license.
non_ai_processing: No generative AI, image synthesis, generative fill, redrawing, or upscaling is used. Existing character assets retain their documented processing. Manga excerpts reproduce the official reader display by deterministic 4×4 tile transposition, followed by a rectangular panel crop and lossless WebP encoding. No recoloring, text replacement, or compositing is applied.
